_comment: SOC Evidence Field Definitions — edit this file to add/remove categories or fields without touching Python code.

_validators.email: Checks for @ and a domain portion
_validators.datetime: Accepts any non-trivial date/time description (3+ chars)
_validators.number: Accepts digits optionally followed by units

_safety_messages.phishing: ⚠️ **Safety Advice:** If you have not already done so, avoid clicking any further links or opening attachments in the suspicious email while we gather the incident details.
_safety_messages.malware: ⚠️ **Containment Advice:** If possible, disconnect the affected device from the network immediately, but do **not** power it off. This helps contain the threat while preserving evidence.
_safety_messages.ransomware: ⚠️ **Containment Advice:** Disconnect the affected device from the network immediately. Do **not** reboot or attempt to modify encrypted files while we collect the incident information.
_safety_messages.account_compromise: ⚠️ **Safety Advice:** If you still have access to the account, avoid making any further changes until we finish collecting the incident details.
_safety_messages.suspicious_login: ⚠️ **Safety Advice:** Do not attempt to log in or recover the account until we have documented all details — this preserves the audit trail.
_safety_messages.data_loss: ⚠️ **Safety Advice:** Do not delete or modify any emails, files, or logs related to this incident. Preserve all evidence as-is.
_safety_messages.usb_device: ⚠️ **Safety Advice:** If the USB device is still connected, safely eject it immediately. Do not run any further files from it or plug it into another device.
_safety_messages.insider_threat: ⚠️ **Safety Advice:** Do **not** confront or alert the individual you suspect, and do not alter or delete any logs or files related to this activity. This is critical for the investigation.
_safety_messages.device_theft: ⚠️ **Safety Advice:** If the device is organisation-managed, do not attempt any remote actions yet. We will coordinate with IT to initiate a remote wipe after this incident is logged.
_safety_messages.unknown: ⚠️ **Note:** We will document the details of this security concern and route it to the appropriate team.

fields.label: Sender Email
fields.question: What was the sender's email address in the suspicious email?

fields.label: Clicked a Link
fields.question: Did you click any link inside the suspicious email? (yes or no)

fields.label: Entered Credentials
fields.question: On any page that opened, did you enter a username, password, or any other credentials? (yes or no)

fields.label: Downloaded Attachment
fields.question: Did you open or download any attachment from the email? (yes or no)

fields.label: When It Happened
fields.question: Approximately when did you receive or interact with this email? (e.g. 'today at 2pm', 'yesterday morning')

fields.label: Affected Device
fields.question: What is the name or description of the affected device? (e.g. 'my work laptop', 'DESKTOP-XYZ')

fields.label: Threat / Alert Name
fields.question: Did your antivirus or security software display an alert? If so, what name or description did it show? (If no alert, type 'none')

fields.label: Network Connected
fields.question: Is the affected device currently connected to the company network? (yes or no)

fields.label: Files Affected
fields.question: Are any files missing, corrupted, renamed, or inaccessible on the device? (yes or no)

fields.label: When It Happened
fields.question: Approximately when did you first notice the issue?

fields.label: Affected Device
fields.question: What is the name or description of the affected device?

fields.label: Files Encrypted
fields.question: Are your files showing strange extensions (e.g. .locked, .encrypted) or are you seeing a ransom note? (yes or no)

fields.label: Ransom Demand
fields.question: Did the ransom note or message specify a payment amount or method? If yes, describe it briefly. If no, type 'no'.

fields.label: Shared Drives Affected
fields.question: Were any shared network drives or folders also encrypted or affected? (yes or no)

fields.label: Network Connected at Time
fields.question: Was the device connected to the company network when the encryption began? (yes or no)

fields.label: When It Happened
fields.question: Approximately when did you first discover the encrypted files or ransom note?

fields.label: Account Type
fields.question: Which account was compromised? (e.g. 'corporate email', 'Microsoft 365', 'VPN account', 'Slack')

fields.label: Still Has Access
fields.question: Can you still log into the compromised account right now? (yes or no)

fields.label: Observed Unauthorized Actions
fields.question: What unauthorized activity did you notice? (e.g. 'emails sent I didn\'t write', 'password changed', 'unknown logins in activity log')

fields.label: Password Already Changed
fields.question: Have you already changed the account password? (yes or no)

fields.label: When Noticed
fields.question: When did you first notice the unauthorized activity?

fields.label: Account
fields.question: Which account received the suspicious login alert? (e.g. 'corporate email', 'Microsoft 365')

fields.label: Login Location / IP
fields.question: What location, country, or IP address was shown in the alert?

fields.label: Login Time
fields.question: What date and time did the suspicious login occur according to the alert?

fields.label: Login Was Yours
fields.question: Could this login have been made by you — for example, were you travelling or using a different device? (yes or no)

fields.label: Account Still Accessible
fields.question: Can you still log into the account right now? (yes or no)

fields.label: Data Description
fields.question: What type of data was lost or exposed? (e.g. 'customer PII', 'financial records', 'HR files', 'source code')

fields.label: Data Sensitivity
fields.question: How sensitive is this data? (e.g. 'confidential', 'internal only', 'public', 'PII/GDPR regulated')

fields.label: Recipient
fields.question: Who received or has access to the exposed data? (e.g. 'external client', 'wrong internal team', 'unknown')

fields.label: Internal or External
fields.question: Was the data sent or exposed to someone outside the organisation? (yes for external, no for internal)

fields.label: When It Happened
fields.question: When did this data exposure occur?

fields.label: Device Description
fields.question: Can you describe the USB device? (e.g. 'black USB stick', 'found in the car park', 'unknown brand')

fields.label: Was USB Inserted
fields.question: Was the USB device inserted into a company computer? (yes or no)

fields.label: Files Executed
fields.question: After inserting the USB, did any program launch automatically, or did you open or run any files from it? (yes or no)

fields.label: Current Device Location
fields.question: Where is the USB device now? (e.g. 'still in my laptop', 'on my desk', 'handed to IT')

fields.label: When It Was Found / Used
fields.question: When did you find or first use this USB device?

fields.label: Observed Activity
fields.question: Without naming the individual yet, what specific activity did you observe that raised concern? (e.g. 'accessing files outside their department', 'copying data to a USB', 'forwarding emails externally')

fields.label: Timeframe
fields.question: When did you first observe this activity? Please provide an approximate date and time.

fields.label: Evidence Available
fields.question: Do you have any evidence of this activity — such as screenshots, access logs, or email trails? (yes or no)

fields.label: Data Exfiltrated
fields.question: To your knowledge, has any sensitive data, customer information, or company assets been removed or copied? (yes or no)

fields.label: Device Type
fields.question: What type of device was stolen or lost? (e.g. 'company laptop', 'personal phone with company data', 'tablet')

fields.label: Theft or Loss
fields.question: Was the device stolen (taken by someone), or was it simply lost? (stolen or lost)

fields.label: Disk Encryption
fields.question: Was full-disk encryption enabled on the device? (e.g. BitLocker, FileVault) — yes, no, or unknown

fields.label: Police Report Filed
fields.question: Have you already filed a police report? (yes or no)

fields.label: When It Happened
fields.question: When did the theft or loss occur?

fields.label: Incident Description
fields.question: Please describe the security concern in as much detail as possible. What happened, when, and what systems or data were involved?

fields.label: Systems Affected
fields.question: Which systems, applications, or accounts are involved? (e.g. 'my laptop', 'email account', 'shared drive')

fields.label: When It Happened
fields.question: When did you first notice this issue?
